description: Use when a student has read a Read Aloud passage aloud and you have the transcript of what they said (for example from voice mode) but no audio. Compares the words said against the passage: omitted, inserted and substituted words and a word-accuracy percentage. CONTENT ONLY — pronunciation, fluency and prosody need a recording: offer speak_practice or the answer link for those.

questionId.description: The questionId returned by speak_practice or practice_question for a Read Aloud passage.

transcript.description: What the student said, as text.

name: check_read_aloud
title: Check a Read Aloud transcript
